description: On the green tablecloth in front of you there’s a small stack of colorful plastic plates near the right side. The left hand reaches in from the lower left, touches the top yellow plate, lifts it off the stack, and slides it left to set it down, then returns to the stack to lift off the green plate and place it beside the yellow; next the left hand moves to the red plate and separates it from the blue plate underneath, leaving the red nearer the front and the blue to the right, with the left hand releasing after each placement.
